description: Each week, holds whichever of Bitcoin and Ether has the higher 4-week return, and cash when both are negative. Falsified if the leader does not keep leading over the next week. Backtested on FinzData crypto daily closes (7-day weeks, weekends included), costs as stated, re-run free on full history.
title: Bitcoin vs Ether dual momentum · 4-week · cash when both fall
